description: 按已登记36官方查询的真实标题/链接定位原期，最多二候选，缓存不重下载，无猜URL
executed_source:
from pathlib import Path
import json,re,unicodedata,hashlib
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
base=Path('reports/research/510300_industrial_complete_original_source_followthrough_v1')
proto=json.loads((base/'protocol.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
results=[];candidates={}
def norm(s):return re.sub(r'\s+','',unicodedata.normalize('NFKC',s))
def period_of(title):
 title=norm(title).removesuffix('-国家统计局')
 m=re.match(r'^(20\d{2})年',title)
 if not m or '工业企业' not in title or '利润' not in title or any(x in title for x in ['解读','工业司','统计师']):return None
 rest=title[m.end():];mo=re.match(r'1[—－\-–至~～一]+(1[0-2]|[2-9])月(?:份)?',rest)
 if mo:return f'{m.group(1)}M{int(mo.group(1)):02d}'
 if re.match(r'(?:全国)?规模以上工业企业',rest) or rest.startswith('全年'):return m.group(1)+'M12'
 return None
for i in range(1,10):
 p=base/f'原查询批{i:02d}实际回执.json';j=json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
 assert len(j['queries'])==4
 text=j['actual_tool_result'];assert isinstance(text,str)
 headers=list(re.finditer(r'(?m)^([^\n]+?) \((https?://[^\s)]+)\)\s*$',text))
 found=[]
 for k,m in enumerate(headers):
  title=m.group(1);url=m.group(2);body=text[m.end():headers[k+1].start() if k+1<len(headers) else len(text)]
  period=period_of(title)
  if period is None and title=='国家统计局信息公开':
   headings=re.findall(r'(?m)^#{1,3}\s+([^\n]+)',body)
   identities=[period_of(t) for t in headings]
   identities=[x for x in identities if x]
   if len(set(identities))==1:period=identities[0]
  item={'original_header_title':title,'url':url,'resolved_original_economic_period_from_title':period,'original_query_batch':i,'source_query_receipt':p.as_posix(),'source_query_sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'original_result_excerpt':body[:3500]}
  found.append(item)
  if period in proto['remaining_fixed_36'] and re.search(r'https://www\.stats\.gov\.cn/(?:sj/zxfb|xxgk/sjfb/zxfb2020)/.+/t\d{8}_\d+\.html$',url):
   key=(period,url)
   if key not in candidates:candidates[key]=item
 results.append({'batch':i,'queries':j['queries'],'all_actual_source_headers':found})
cache={}
e88=Path('reports/research/510300_industrial_multidimensional_cash_constraint_source_v1')
j=json.loads((e88/'原首批5当前原全文与取得回执.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
for r in j['targets']:cache[r['url']]={'path':r['html_path'],'sha256':r['sha256'],'source':'E88缓存'}
e89=Path('reports/research/510300_industrial_cash_constraint_original_panel_v1')
j=json.loads((e89/'全部实际原报告取得回执_缺失保留.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
for r in j['attempts']:
 if r.get('path'):cache[r['requested_url']]={'path':r['path'],'sha256':r['sha256'],'source':'E89缓存'}
e91=Path('reports/research/510300_industrial_full_government_original_carrier_probe_v1')
j=json.loads((e91/'首四不同原载体实际取得及所有原表链接.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
for r in j['reports']:
 if r.get('path'):cache[r['url']]={'path':r['path'],'sha256':r['sha256'],'source':'E91缓存'}
mapping=[];selected=[]
for p in proto['remaining_fixed_36']:
 cs=[x for (period,url),x in candidates.items() if period==p]
 cs.sort(key=lambda x:(0 if '/sj/zxfb/' in x['url'] else 1,x['url']))
 cs=cs[:2]
 item={'economic_period':p,'locator_status':'ACTUAL_SOURCE_TITLE_FOUND' if cs else 'UNKNOWN_NOT_LOCATED','candidates':cs,'candidate_count':len(cs)}
 mapping.append(item)
 if cs:
  chosen={**cs[0],'economic_period':p}
  if chosen['url'] in cache:chosen['cached_reuse']=cache[chosen['url']]
  selected.append(chosen)
def save(name,x):
 p=base/name;assert not p.exists()
 p.write_text(json.dumps(x,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
save('全部36原查询实际来源标题及拒绝范围.json',{'actual_official_queries':36,'batches':results,'no_new_labels_or_models':True})
save('固定36原期真实定位及最多两候选登记.json',mapping)
save('第一候选真实来源请求前登记.json',{'at':datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat(),'actual_selected':selected,'new_raw_GETs_planned':sum('cached_reuse' not in x for x in selected),'cached_reuse_count':sum('cached_reuse' in x for x in selected),'all36_targets_preserved':True,'new_stock_labels':0,'no_guessed_URLs':True,'per_source_attempt':1})
print(json.dumps({'已查询':36,'标题真实定位':len(selected),'新原GET拟取':sum('cached_reuse' not in x for x in selected),'原缓存复用':sum('cached_reuse' in x for x in selected),'原未定位':[x['economic_period'] for x in mapping if not x['candidate_count']],'实际原定位':[(x['economic_period'],x['url']) for x in selected]},ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
